rationale: The1.5x rate scale improved some early points but failed both registered endpoint measures and both last-three means. Its first-seed screen closed without confirmation.
Keep the stronger existing1e-3 to3e-4 schedule. Both training probe and validation still improve, so there is no sustained-overfit evidence for reducing the dataset or horizon.

Test whether starting the spatial encoder residual branches at1e-2 improves optimization. The current1e-6 initialization grows to median magnitudes around0.03–0.05 in both completed seeds; those observations motivate a moderate startup probe without establishing an optimum.
Only encoder initialization changes. Width, depth, spatial attention, shared passes, soft-token connector, readout, auxiliary objective, parameter count and complete decoding FLOPs stay fixed.
scope: A selected isolated encoder initialization probe, to be registered before learning. It is not a claim that the transformer already beats CNN or that larger residual scales are better.
